figures.name: moving-jumps
figures.title: Moving jumps and continuity points
figures.alt: Solid CDFs jump at 1/n; the dashed limit jumps at zero. At zero the values never agree, although convergence holds at every continuity point of the limit.

figures.name: replacement-rows
figures.title: Replace one observation at a time
figures.alt: Seven rows show all six replacement steps from Gaussian Y terms to original X terms. The outlined slot is the term just replaced, while the other five terms stay fixed.
